name: Iza, Shutsujin! Koi Ikusa
source:
Revive the Sengoku romance with Iza, Shutsujin! Koi Ikusa. Princess Hana is entrusted with the fate of her country by her dying father. In the chaotic era, she is forced to negotiate with powerful warriors and deal with their different types of personalities.

[From [url=http://www.play-asia.com/Iza_Shutsujin_Koisen/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-46bo.html]Play-asia.com[/url]]
translation:
在《出陣！戀戰》中重溫戰國時代的浪漫。父親臨終前把國家命運託付給御柳華公主。亂世之中，她被迫與各路強大武將談判，還要應付他們截然不同的性格。

[譯自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/Iza_Shutsujin_Koisen/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-46bo.html]Play-Asia.com[/url]]
